name: flutter-code-quality
description: Flutter architecture and quality conventions, adapted to your stack through a project profile. Layering with a pure Dart domain, state rules for Bloc, Cubit and Riverpod, responsive layout, accessibility and RTL requirements that design files never specify, performance rules, and a read-only pre-commit review gate.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture, accessibility, performance, and review workflows for Flutter.
interface.longDescription: Flutter engineering workflows that adapt to the project's stack and enforce architecture, state, responsive layout, accessibility, RTL, performance, reuse, and pre-commit quality checks.
defaultPrompt: Adapt the Flutter skills to this project.
Review this Flutter change before I commit.
Implement this feature using the project's conventions.
